title: A zone's header: data/zones/<zone>.json
description: One zone's header, 0x30 bytes, which ZoneData_GetHeader returns and the ZoneData_ and GetZone functions read. tools/data/zone_data.py packs them in the order of data/constants/zones.txt into the single entry of archive a/0/1/2. A string value is the name of a constant from data/constants/ or include/constants/.

area.description: The area: its textures and buildings

matrix.description: The map matrix, a MAP_MATRIX_* constant, data/map_matrices/<name>.json

scripts.description: The zone's field script file, a SCRIPTS_* constant, data/field_scripts/<name>.s

init_scripts.description: Left out, as in every zone, it is the script file after scripts, the zone's SCRIPTS_INIT_*; nothing reads it

text.description: The zone's script message file, a SCRIPT_TEXT_* constant, data/text/script/<name>.txt

bgm.description: The music (SEQ_*), or an object with the music of each season

encounters.description: The wild encounter table, an ENCOUNTERS_* constant, or null for none

enc_slot.description: The zone's 3-bit slot in a save word, 6 for none

parent.description: The zone this one belongs to, a ZONE_* constant

place.description: The place, a PLACE_* constant, whose name data/places/ has

place_display.description: How the place name is shown

transition.description: The effect of entering the map

escape_rope.description: Whether the zone allows Escape Rope

fly_from.description: Whether the player can fly from the zone

flag11.description: Left out, as in every zone, it is set; nothing reads it

name_icon.description: The icon of the place name

easy_level.description: The level adjustment of Easy Mode

fly.description: Where flying lands: a grid position, or a rail position (component, front and side) for a zone with rails
